_comment: Lane E app-registration governance control map (Vol IX Book 03). App registrations as machine JML: request → scoped consent → short-lived credential → rotate → attest. Actuation via Graph through the in-boundary MID; no long-lived secrets. Projection of aan-compliance-spine.yml. Scope: FedRAMP Moderate + GCC Moderate.

appreg.request.title: Request app registration
appreg.request.note: Capture owner, purpose, and the specific scopes needed.

appreg.consent.title: Grant scoped admin consent
appreg.consent.note: Least privilege; any privileged/write scope requires a security approver.

appreg.credential.issue.title: Issue short-lived credential
appreg.credential.issue.note: Certificate (ACME) or secret with MANDATORY expiry — no long-lived secrets in config (SC-17).

appreg.credential.rotate.title: Rotate credential (automated)
appreg.credential.rotate.note: Automated rotation before expiry; the app never depends on a human remembering.

appreg.attest.title: Re-attest ownership & scope
appreg.attest.note: Cadence re-attestation; orphaned/expired registrations flagged (feeds Vol VII Book 04, CA-7).
